kicker: Cervical Cancer · Br J Cancer 2025;132:1064–1071 · Multicenter Prospective
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Br J Cancer 2025;132:1064–1071 · 多中心前瞻
title: Cytological DNA Methylation Triage in Non-16/18 hrHPV+ Women with Genotyping
title_zh: 非16/18高危HPV阳性女性中细胞学DNA甲基化分流与分型
subtitle: 1,307 non-16/18 hrHPV+ women — CISCER(+) CIN3+ risk 39.1% vs 0.9% when negative; OR 68.07
subtitle_zh: 1,307 例非16/18 hrHPV+ 女性——CISCER(+) 即时 CIN3+ 风险 39.1% vs 阴性 0.9%；OR 68.07
authors: Su H, Jin X, Kong L, You Y, et al.
authors_zh: 苏海琦, 金西桐, 孔令华, 尤燕 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: non-16/18 hrHPV+ women lack a reliable triage — cytology is subjective and genotype-based referral (e.g. HPV33/35) misses many CIN3+.
Question: does cytological PAX1/JAM3 methylation triage non-16/18 hrHPV+ women better than LBC or HPV33/35 genotyping?
Why it matters: an objective triage for the largest hrHPV group could standardize management and cut referrals.
bullets_zh: 空白：非16/18 hrHPV+ 女性缺乏可靠分流——细胞学主观、基于型别的转诊（如 HPV33/35）漏诊许多 CIN3+。
问题：细胞学 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化分流非16/18 hrHPV+ 女性是否优于 LBC 或 HPV33/35 分型？
意义：为最大 hrHPV 人群提供客观分流，可标准化管理并减少转诊。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: multicenter prospective cohorts (METHY3/METHY4, 2020–2022); histology reference.
Population: 1,307 non-16/18 hrHPV+; 643 with pathology (406 normal / 124 CIN1 / 64 CIN2 / 40 CIN3 / 9 cancer).
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); HybriBio 21-type genotyping; LBC.
Comparison: CISCER vs LBC ≥ASCUS vs HPV33/35+ for CIN3+.
bullets_zh: 设计：多中心前瞻队列（METHY3/METHY4，2020–2022）；组织学金标准。
人群：非16/18 hrHPV+ 1,307 例；643 例有病理（正常 406 / CIN1 124 / CIN2 64 / CIN3 40 / 癌 9）。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；HybriBio 21型分型；LBC。
比较：CISCER vs LBC ≥ASCUS vs HPV33/35+ 检测 CIN3+。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Risk stratification: CISCER(+) immediate CIN3+ risk 39.1% vs 0.9% (−); LBC ≥ASCUS only 9.8%, HPV33/35+ 19.3%.
CIN2+: sensitivity 76.1% · specificity 95.1% · AUC 0.856; CIN3+ AUC 0.892 — both above LBC and HPV33/35.
Unique predictor: CISCER(+) was the only independent CIN3+ risk factor (OR 68.07).
Referral: CISCER+ 17.4% vs LBC 61.9% vs HPV33/35+ 8.9% — 2.5 referrals per CIN3+ detected.
bullets_zh: 风险分层：CISCER(+) 即时 CIN3+ 风险 39.1% vs 阴性 0.9%；LBC ≥ASCUS 仅 9.8%，HPV33/35+ 19.3%。
CIN2+：灵敏度 76.1% · 特异度 95.1% · AUC 0.856；CIN3+ AUC 0.892——均高于 LBC 与 HPV33/35。
唯一独立预测因子：CISCER(+) 是 CIN3+ 的唯一独立危险因素（OR 68.07）。
转诊：CISCER+ 17.4% vs LBC 61.9% vs HPV33/35+ 8.9%——每检出 1 例 CIN3+ 仅 2.5 次转诊。

panels.title: Combination insight
bullets: CISCER + HPV33/35: dual-positive women had the highest CIN3+ risk (50.0%) — genotyping adds orthogonal risk.
Risk gradient: CISCER(+) & HPV33/35(−) still 32.3% — methylation dominates the risk signal.
Policy: methylation triage plus selective genotyping could replace cytology in non-16/18 hrHPV+ management.
bullets_zh: CISCER + HPV33/35：双阳性女性 CIN3+ 风险最高（50.0%）——分型提供正交风险。
风险梯度：CISCER(+) 且 HPV33/35(−) 仍达 32.3%——甲基化主导风险信号。
政策：甲基化分流 + 选择性分型可取代非16/18 hrHPV+ 管理中的细胞学。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation dominates non-16/18 triage: OR 68.07, CIN3+ AUC 0.892, risk 39.1% vs 0.9%.
Far fewer referrals: 17.4% vs 61.9% (LBC) — objective, genotype-aware triage for the largest hrHPV group.
bullets_zh: 甲基化主导非16/18分流：OR 68.07，CIN3+ AUC 0.892，风险 39.1% vs 0.9%。
转诊大幅减少：17.4% vs 61.9%（LBC）——最大 hrHPV 人群的客观、型别感知分流。

kicker: Cervical Cancer · The Oncologist 2025;30:oyae324 · Prospective Cohort
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · The Oncologist 2025;30:oyae324 · 前瞻队列
title: DNA Methylation Triage for hrHPV-Positive Women
title_zh: hrHPV阳性女性的 DNA 甲基化分流
subtitle: 4,394 hrHPV+ women from the METHY3 cohort — CISCER specificity 89.6% vs 23.9% (LBC); 61% fewer referrals
subtitle_zh: METHY3 队列 4,394 例 hrHPV+ 女性——CISCER 特异度 89.6% vs 23.9%（LBC）；转诊减少 61%
authors: Kong L, Xiao X, Wu H, You Y, et al.
authors_zh: 孔令华, 肖晓萍, 吴焕文, 尤燕 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: hrHPV positivity is common but most infections clear — triage is needed to avoid overwhelming colposcopy services.
Question: how does PAX1m/JAM3m compare with HPV16/18 typing and LBC for triaging hrHPV+ women?
Why it matters: the right triage balances CIN3+ detection against referral burden at population scale.
bullets_zh: 空白：hrHPV 阳性常见但多数感染会清除——需要分流以避免阴道镜服务不堪重负。
问题：PAX1m/JAM3m 与 HPV16/18 分型、LBC 相比，分流 hrHPV+ 女性表现如何？
意义：正确的分流在人群尺度上平衡 CIN3+ 检出与转诊负担。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective METHY3 cohort (20,456 women, Nov 2020–Dec 2021); Peking Union Medical College Hospital; single-center analysis.
Population: 4,394 hrHPV+; 1,105 with pathology (615 normal / 255 CIN1 / 112 CIN2 / 95 CIN3 / 28 cancer).
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); Cobas 4800; LBC.
Outcome: CIN3+ triage vs HPV16/18+ and LBC ≥ASCUS.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻 METHY3 队列（20,456 例，2020.11–2021.12）；北京协和医院；单中心分析。
人群：hrHPV+ 4,394 例；1,105 例有病理（正常 615 / CIN1 255 / CIN2 112 / CIN3 95 / 癌 28）。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；Cobas 4800；LBC。
结局：CIN3+ 分流 vs HPV16/18+ 与 LBC ≥ASCUS。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: PAX1m/JAM3m: CIN3+ sensitivity 68.3% · specificity 89.6% · AUC 0.790 · OR 18.5 (12.1–28.7).
Comparators: HPV16/18+ 68.3%/66.4% (OR 4.24); LBC ≥ASCUS 93.5%/23.9% (OR 4.44).
All 28 cancers detected by methylation.
Referrals: 16.83% (methylation) vs 37.47% (HPV16/18) vs 78.01% (LBC) — 20.6 and 61.2 percentage points fewer.
bullets_zh: PAX1m/JAM3m：CIN3+ 灵敏度 68.3% · 特异度 89.6% · AUC 0.790 · OR 18.5（12.1–28.7）。
28 例宫颈癌全部检出（甲基化）。
转诊：16.83%（甲基化）vs 37.47%（HPV16/18）vs 78.01%（LBC）——分别少 20.6 与 61.2 个百分点。

panels.title: Age-stratified
bullets: AUC by age: <30 y 0.669 · 30–49 y 0.777 · ≥50 y 0.829 — accuracy improves with age.
Elderly benefit: highest AUC in ≥50 y — exactly where cytology is least reliable.
Young women: lower AUC reflects lower CIN3+ prevalence — but specificity still protects against over-referral.
bullets_zh: 年龄分层 AUC：<30 岁 0.669 · 30–49 岁 0.777 · ≥50 岁 0.829——准确性随年龄提高。
老年获益：≥50 岁 AUC 最高——恰在细胞学最不可靠处。
年轻女性：AUC 较低反映 CIN3+ 患病率低——但特异度仍防止过度转诊。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Best specificity triage: 89.6% vs 23.9% (LBC) and 66.4% (HPV16/18) — with OR 18.5 for CIN3+.
61% fewer referrals than LBC at population scale — methylation triage protects screening programs from colposcopy overload.
bullets_zh: 特异度最佳的分流：89.6% vs 23.9%（LBC）与 66.4%（HPV16/18）——CIN3+ OR 18.5。
比 LBC 少 61% 转诊——人群尺度上保护筛查项目免于阴道镜超载。
